summary: Iteration 12 (PIN codes + per-PIN delivery + per-PIN inventory) tested end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_pin_inventory_iter12.py covering /pincodes/check (serviceable/unserviceable), admin PIN list, per-PIN inventory listing, per-PIN summary, PIN isolation (setting stock in 500034 does NOT change 500073), disabling a product for one PIN hides it from /products?pincode= only for that PIN, enable-all for single PIN and all_serviceable, checkout uses per-PIN delivery_charge (verified by mutating PIN charge to 77 and observing order.delivery_charge == 77 with ASAP surcharge additive on top), inventory reservation on order + restore on cancel, unserviceable PIN blocked at address creation (server-side validation). Frontend Playwright verified: LocationModal — unserviceable PIN 999999 shows 'we don't deliver' and 'Shop this area' is hidden; serviceable PIN 500034 shows 'Shop this area', clicking persists pincode=500034 in localStorage and header switches to Hyderabad-Central delivery. Admin PIN Inventory (/admin/inventory) loads, PIN select works (30 rows for 500034), search/status filter present, enable-all-pin & enable-all-serviceable buttons render, per-row enable-toggle-<pid>, stock-input-<pid>, save-stock-<pid> all functional (edited stock 100->55 saved and persisted). Delivery ₹40 badge shows the PIN's charge on the admin page.

issues: After selecting PIN 500034 the header pill still reads 'Banjara Hills' while the toast confirms 'Hyderabad - Central (500034)'. The parent-location display in the header is technically correct (PIN 500034's parent is Banjara Hills sub-area), but the mismatch with the toast wording can confuse users. Recommend using a single canonical location label.

action_items: (Optional) Align header 'Deliver to' label with the toast so both show the same location name after switching PIN.

(Pre-existing, not iter12) test_combo_edit_iter11.py::test_disallowed_swap_rejected now returns 200 instead of 400 — swap validation may have regressed on packages.price_and_validate_combo; verify allowed alternatives enforcement.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/products.list_products filters PIN availability AFTER enrich() loops every product. For large catalogs, load enabled_ids first and filter the mongo query with {'id': {'$in': enabled_ids}} to avoid enriching products that will be dropped.

routers/inventory.list_inventory returns rows only for products.is_active=True but 'configured' flag is derived from inventory presence — a legitimate 'not-yet-configured' state. Consider a Configure toggle in UI so admins understand un-enabled products explicitly (currently Enabled toggle is off by default when inv doc missing).

routers/orders._reserve_inventory does not fall back or fail if PIN inventory row is missing but location-level exists. _inv_filter switches to location key when 'no PIN doc'. This is safe today (backfill created rows), but silently mixing PIN and location inventory can drift totals; log a warning when falling back.

routers/pincodes.check_pincode uses pincode.strip() but /admin/pincodes.update_pincode strips only inside PinCodeInput.pincode. Ensure Pydantic model strips consistently to avoid duplicate PIN docs with trailing whitespace.

routers/addresses._assert_serviceable + create_address auto-overwrite payload.location_id with pin.location_id — behaviour is correct but undocumented; add a note in the API response so frontend knows the corrected location.
